title: Synthetic Data Generation for Cameroon Trauma Registry (CTR) using Synthpop and LLMs
summary: A research project generating synthetic health records from the Cameroon Trauma Registry, comparing a Synthpop (R) baseline against a fine-tuned LLM-based (GReaT-inspired) tabular data generator, evaluated for statistical utility and privacy. The sdmetrics package's DiagnosticReport and QualityReport are run directly to evaluate the utility of the generated synthetic datasets against real data.
evidence: synthetic_sdmetrics.ipynb: 'from sdmetrics.reports.single_table import QualityReport' and 'quality_report.generate(df_real, df_fake_R, metadata)'
